description: Reports suggest Nottingham Forest is set to sign Ousmane Diomande, while Liverpool is also linked with the player according to recent news.

sections.heading: Nottingham Forest Agreement
paragraphs: According to The New York Times, Nottingham Forest is set to sign Ousmane Diomande from Sporting CP. The publication reports the transfer fee is set at €40m.

sections.heading: Liverpool Interest
paragraphs: Football365 reports that Liverpool has been tipped to hijack the transfer. This comes after the outlet noted that a deal with Nottingham Forest was reportedly 'practically finalised' for the £34m star.

sections.heading: Sporting CP's Transfer Business
paragraphs: Goal.com states that Sporting Portugal is set to secure a fourth major summer transfer windfall with the sale of Ousmane Diomandé.

faq.q: What is the reported transfer fee for Ousmane Diomande?
faq.a: The New York Times reports a fee of €40m, while Football365 refers to the player as a £34m star.

faq.q: Which clubs are pursuing Ousmane Diomande?
faq.a: The New York Times links Nottingham Forest to a move, while Football365 suggests Liverpool may also attempt to sign the player.

faq.q: Which club is selling Ousmane Diomande?
faq.a: Both The New York Times and Goal.com identify Sporting CP as the selling club.
